name: Neogen Corporation
summary: Neogen Corporation develops, manufactures, and markets various products and services for food and animal safety in the United States and internationally. It operates through Food Safety and Animal Safety segments. The company offers diagnostic test kits and complementary products to detect dangerous and/or unintended substances in human food and animal feed, such as foodborne pathogens, spoilage organisms, natural toxins, food allergens, ruminant by-products, meat speciation, drug residues, pesticide residues, and general sanitation concerns.
